name: Snow Hound
desc: Man's best friend!\nSnow Dogs possess incredible endurance and a gentle temperament, so people fitted them with harnesses and had them pull sleds, forming the first transport teams on the snowfields.\nToday, dog sledding has gradually become a tourist attraction in the Border Town, and a competitive sport for a few to Salute tradition, but the residents of the snowfields still regard Snow Dogs as their closest companions, just as they always have.
